description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to award a sole source purchase order to Spryson America, Inc. for Spryson DX200 Head-mounted 3D Goggle Systems which is the system being used in ongoing research being conducted by the Research Department of the Iowa City VA Healthcare System.
The NAICS code is 334510 and the size standard is 1250 employees. The PSC is 6515.
HOW TO RESPOND:

All responses must have the VA Identifier: 36C26326Q0466 in the subject line of the email.
All responses must be received no later than: 04:30pm Central Time, Wednesday March 25, 2026.
All responses must be submitted to this email address:  Joseph.Bennett@va.gov

See Attached Document: Intent to Sole Source 36C26326Q0466 Description and Instructions
